audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows contradicted their own whys in both layers. Level 1 said Skill while whys[0] calls it 'your weakest window'; Levels 2 and 3 said Poppy while whys[1] describes a burst spike she can't answer and whys[2] calls level 3 'a coinflip'; Levels 4-5 said Skill while whys[3] says she edges it; Level 6 said Skill while whys[4] calls it 'your prime all-in'; first item said Poppy while whys[5] says the window stays contested.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Poppy / Skill / Skill / Poppy / Jax / Skill / Poppy and matches the prose row for row. At 48.46% this is a lane Jax loses on the edges and wins at 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 flipped as matched full/content pairs, with the Level 6 rating raised to match a Jax row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase whys were generic and carried no numbers, and the Level 6 row did not say what actually changes.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s — a very long cooldown early, and the single window Jax's whole pattern depends on. Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s, Keeper's Verdict 140/120/100s, Grandmaster's Might 110s.
audit.corrected: Phase whys rebuilt on Steadfast Presence's 20s at rank 1 and the Level 6 ultimate mismatch.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate written as 'Grandmaster at Arms' in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid. The page also never mentions that Keeper's Verdict is a channel.
audit.why: Fabricated ability name in three fields. Keeper's Verdict is flagged channel in the kit — any CC cancels it, so a Counter Strike recast landing on a charging Poppy ends her ultimate outright. That is a decisive, actionable interaction and it was absent. The page's W-grounding coverage is otherwise correct: Steadfast Presence stops Leap Strike mid-dash and grounds, which is why the bait comes first.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster's Might everywhere; the R-channel interrupt added to the Level 6 phase and to mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Steadfast Presence is called matchup-defining with no cooldown given anywhere on the page.
audit.why: 20s at rank 1 falling to 12s at rank 5 is the whole rhythm of this lane — a baited W is a 20-second window early and only a 12-second one late, which is exactly why Jax's good stretch is levels 2-6.
audit.corrected: The number is now in the Level 3 and Levels 4-5 phases.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Poppy's Steadfast Presence is down.
edits.after: Take W: Leap Strike into an Empowered landing hit is real burst her even trades cannot answer if her W is down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Poppy must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence is 20s at rank 1 and stops Leap Strike mid-dash — bait it on a minion or a fake step, then commit.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Steadfast Presence's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Hers: Heroic Charge (14s) pins you to a wall for the stun and her Q zone slows, so walk up only inside her W's 20s downtime.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Poppy's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might (110s) out-durables her, and Keeper's Verdict is a channel — your stun recast cancels it outright. Your prime all-in.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms' Armor/MR active and third-hit on-hit win the extended duel even after she grounds you — this is your prime all-in.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might's Armor/MR active and third-hit on-hit win the extended duel even after she grounds you — this is your prime all-in.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms: the Armor/MR active plus the third-hit on-hit lets you out-DPS her in an extended duel even after she grounds your engage — your prime all-in.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might: the Armor/MR active plus the third-hit on-hit lets you out-DPS her in an extended duel even after she grounds your engage — your prime all-in.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay even because she trades you straight up, and her E-into-wall stun plus her Q slow zone punish you whenever you walk up on her cooldowns — so only trade when her W is down. Six is your moment: Grandmaster at Arms gives the Armor/MR active and the third-hit bonus on-hit, which lets you win the extended duel even after she grounds your engage, because once you are on her, Counter Strike eats her autos and your R durability outlasts her. Bait the W, E to dodge her auto-trade, recast for the stun, and run the full pattern.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are hers: she trades straight up, and Heroic Charge (14s) into a wall plus her Q slow zone punish you whenever you walk up on her cooldowns — so trade only inside her W's 20s downtime. Six is your moment: Grandmaster's Might gives the Armor/MR active and the third-hit on-hit, so you win the extended duel even after she grounds your engage. Keeper's Verdict is a channel — if she starts winding it up, your Counter Strike recast cancels it. Bait the W, eat her autos on the dodge, recast, run the pattern.

notes: Six of seven chart rows disagreed with their own whys.
